# TypeScript/JavaScript best practices (Accelint)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @gohypergiant's Accelint TypeScript/JavaScript best-practices skill: comprehensive coding standards for AI agents and LLMs, organized for progressive disclosure to save context. Start with `AGENTS.md` for one-line rule summaries, then load only the relevant `references/` file — naming conventions, function design, control flow, state management, return values (zero values instead of null/undefined), code duplication, `any` avoidance, const objects over enums, type-vs-interface, statically analyzable bundler paths, input validation with schemas, assertions, explicit error handling and error messages — each with ❌ incorrect / ✅ correct examples. When invoked for an audit it produces a standardized report (executive summary, severity levels, impact analysis, categorization, pattern references, phase-2 tracking table) from `assets/output-report-template.md`; plain "fix this error" requests skip the template. Honest caveats: methodology only — the agent needs a JS/TS codebase to apply it to; performance optimization and documentation are explicitly out of scope (sibling `accelint-ts-performance` / `accelint-ts-documentation` skills). Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
